unresolved.what: Malagasy provinces 1946 → 1956-11 (five provinces: Tananarive, Fianarantsoa, Tamatave, Majunga, Tuléar)
unresolved.why: Diégo-Suarez province was carved in November 1956 out of the northern parts of Majunga and Tamatave, so before it those two provinces reached the north. The 1962 Code officiel géographique numbers the Diégo-Suarez sous-préfectures 7-10..7-12 (Antalaha, Sambava, Andapa) and 7-15..7-19 (Diégo-Suarez, Vohémar, Ambilobe, Nossi-Bé, Ambanja), exactly the numbers missing from Tamatave (3-10..3-12) and Majunga (4-15..4-19) — which implies Vohémar came from Majunga and the rest of Sava from Tamatave; that line runs inside the Sava atom of this set. The same code list also leaves Tuléar without 5-12..5-14 while Fianarantsoa ends with Ihosy, Vondrozo and Ivohibe (2-16..2-18), a sign of other undated transfers between 1946 and 1962, so the 1960 outlines cannot simply be carried back.
